description.zh: 用于保证请求的幂等性，防止重复提交请求。由客户端生成该参数值，保证在不同请求间唯一，大小写敏感、不超过64个ASCII字符。
description.en: A client token to ensure the idempotence of the request. The client generates this token. It must be unique across requests, case-sensitive, and up to 64 ASCII characters in length.

description.zh:
数据库备注说明，备注说明需满足如下要求： 
* 不能以`http://`或`https://`开头。 
* 长度为2~256个字符。
description.en:
The description of the database. The description must meet the following requirements:

- It cannot start with `http://` or `https://`.

- It must be 2 to 256 characters in length.

title.zh: 修改边缘集群数据库备注

example.unifiedCli: aliyun polardb modify-db-description-zonal --db-cluster-id pc-00000000000000 --db-name testDB --db-description testdesc --client-token 6000170000591aed949d0f54a343f1a4233c1e7d1c5000000 --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun polardb ModifyDBDescriptionZonal --region cn-hangzhou --DBDescription testdesc --DBClusterId 'pc-00000000000000' --DBName testDB --ClientToken 6000170000591aed949d0f54a343f1a4233c1e7d1c5000000
